coverage.notes: Enumerated all 16 undergraduate single/dual options visible in the live AUPP admissions major menu (observed 19 October 2026); eight single and eight dual routes. All undergraduate classes are taught in English on the AUPP Phnom Penh campus. The application form still displayed a Spring 2026 semester and the academic calendar index linked Fall 2026 rather than Fall 2027, so completeness and precise availability for first-year 2027 are unverified. Dual routes are selectable interests at first year but actual US-partner applications occur after sophomore year. Masters, English foundation and business concentrations were excluded. Two programme pages yielded no readable body, so only officially established programme identities were retained for those descriptions.

institution.summary: Private Cambodian university in Phnom Penh with four undergraduate faculties, English-taught degrees and US partner awards.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Business (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Business
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: AUPP’s single-degree business programme covers management, finance, marketing, accounting and economic decision-making.
programmes.overview: The course brings together the major functional areas of business: accounting, finance, marketing and management. Students study economic ideas, quantitative relationships and general education alongside professional business subjects. Coursework emphasizes analysis, written and oral communication, teamwork and ethical decision-making. The degree is intended as a broad preparation for work in businesses, public organisations or entrepreneurial settings.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Business + University of Arizona Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: A dual business degree combining AUPP’s business curriculum with University of Arizona courses in business administration.
programmes.overview: Students study accounting, economics, applied statistics, business communication, finance and management across AUPP and University of Arizona components. The curriculum also includes general education and elective study, with requirements specified by both institutions. University of Arizona admission to its partner component is conditional on meeting its cumulative-GPA and course-grade rules. This pathway is designed to combine broad business preparation with a second award from the US partner.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Communication (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Business + University of Arizona Bachelor of Arts in Communication
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: A communication and business dual-degree track leading to AUPP and University of Arizona bachelor’s awards.
programmes.overview: The programme connects the study of communication with business principles rather than treating media and commerce separately. Students develop written and spoken communication, persuasive presentation, marketing and branding knowledge, alongside business subjects such as management and finance. The university identifies public relations, advertising, corporate communication and media-related functions as potential applications. Successful completion of the partner requirements leads to an AUPP business degree and a University of Arizona communication degree.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Information Science and e-Society (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Business + University of Arizona Bachelor of Arts in Information Science and e-Society
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: This dual-degree programme combines business with information science, digital technology and the study of online society.
programmes.overview: Students examine the ways information technology changes organisations, economic activity and social interaction. Topics described by AUPP include data management, social media, digital technologies, data interpretation and their ethical and legal implications. Business study sits alongside the information-science curriculum, connecting technological questions to commercial and organisational decisions. The two awarding institutions are AUPP for business and the University of Arizona for information science and e-Society.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in International Relations and Diplomacy (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Arts in International Relations and Diplomacy
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: This degree studies diplomacy, international politics, policy and contemporary challenges in Southeast Asia and beyond.
programmes.overview: Students explore conflict, political change, globalisation, diplomacy and the influence of governments and other international actors. They analyse foreign and domestic policy questions, including development and security, with particular reference to Southeast Asia. Teaching uses problem-centred approaches and evidence-based social-science analysis, combining theory with qualitative or quantitative methods. The programme includes original research and a capstone project within its four-year curriculum.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Political Science (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Arts in International Relations and Diplomacy + Fort Hays State University Bachelor of Science in Political Science
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: A dual political-science route combining AUPP’s international-relations degree with a Fort Hays State University award.
programmes.overview: The programme covers political theory, American and international political systems, government and public administration. Students also study policy, political management, democratic engagement and international affairs. Its teaching combines theoretical coursework with case studies and applied activities, alongside the international-relations component from AUPP. Graduates meeting the combined curriculum can earn an AUPP BA in International Relations and Diplomacy and a Fort Hays State University BSc in Political Science.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Law (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Arts in Law
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: AUPP’s law degree develops legal reasoning and writing through Cambodian, international and comparative legal study.
programmes.overview: Students learn legal analysis, research, writing and negotiation through courses including contracts, criminal law, business law, intellectual property and international law. The programme considers Cambodian, United States, comparative and international legal systems, with ethics running through the curriculum. The university describes practical opportunities such as internships with law firms, government ministries and other organisations. It prepares students for legal and law-related work while also developing analytical skills used in business and government.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Law (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Arts in Law + University of Arizona Bachelor of Arts in Law
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: AUPP’s dual law route combines its legal curriculum with University of Arizona requirements for a second law award.
programmes.overview: The programme combines Cambodian legal subjects with comparative, international and US-related legal study. Students take legal foundations, ethics, criminal procedure and civil law, and develop practical skills in research, argumentation and legal drafting. AUPP lists moot court, intellectual property, labour and family law among its major courses, together with an internship. The dual structure includes prescribed University of Arizona modules and limits some elective choices to satisfy both award requirements.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: A computing degree focused on artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI and responsible applications.
programmes.overview: The curriculum introduces artificial intelligence before developing machine-learning and generative-AI approaches. Students study how to design, implement and evaluate AI models for practical problems through projects and collaborative work. The programme also addresses the ethical and social consequences of deploying AI systems. Its stated learning outcomes combine analytical reasoning, technological adaptability and communication of AI solutions, providing preparation for technical work or further AI study.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Cybersecurity
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: A specialist degree in digital security covering network defence, encryption, risk assessment and vulnerability analysis.
programmes.overview: Students investigate the security of digital systems and information, including cryptography, network defence and risk management. Practical exercises address penetration-testing concepts, identifying vulnerabilities and designing security policies. The programme also develops skills in recognising attack patterns and evaluating protection strategies as technology changes. Its learning outcomes emphasise privacy, ethical decision-making, technical communication and teamwork when responding to cyber threats.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Digital Infrastructure (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Digital Infrastructure
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: This computing degree studies cloud services, infrastructure architecture, virtualisation, containers and secure deployment.
programmes.overview: Students learn how cloud platforms and infrastructure services are designed, deployed and managed. Core themes include cloud architecture, virtualisation, containers and the management of scalable and secure computing environments. Practical projects provide experience applying infrastructure concepts to organisational needs. The programme develops the ability to assess cloud systems, interpret technical metrics and communicate implementation decisions to technical and non-technical audiences.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Information and Communications Technology (Single Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Information and Communications Technology
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: AUPP’s ICT degree connects computer-based information systems with networks, telecommunications and organisational needs.
programmes.overview: The programme studies information systems and their role in business analysis and communication. Students encounter network infrastructure and security, telecommunications, data science, software engineering and management information systems. General education and management principles complement technical study, building analytical, communication and problem-solving skills. AUPP describes practical technical work and laboratory activities as part of the programme’s intended learning outcomes.

programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science / Information Technology Management (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Information Technology Management + Fort Hays State University Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: This dual-degree route connects computing with information-technology management and the needs of business organisations.
programmes.overview: Students examine how computer systems and technology services support organisational strategy and business processes. The AUPP programme combines information-technology management, technical subjects, communications and general education. The published curriculum also requires university-level mathematics and laboratory science, technical writing, a senior project and an internship; these are degree-course requirements, not IB admission prerequisites. The partner award is a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Fort Hays State University.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems / Data Analytics (Dual Degree)

programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia

programmes.name: Bachelor of Science in Web and Mobile Application Development / Interactive App Design (Dual Degree)
programmes.credential: AUPP Bachelor of Science in Interactive App Design and Development + Fort Hays State University Bachelor of Science in Web and Mobile Application Development
programmes.campus: AUPP main campus, Phnom Penh, Cambodia
programmes.about: A dual-degree track in designing, building and maintaining web and mobile applications across platforms.
programmes.overview: The programme teaches the development of interactive applications for web and mobile use, including front-end and back-end programming. Students study user interfaces, responsive design and how to create usable experiences on different devices. Learning outcomes emphasise technical troubleshooting, programming frameworks, design decisions and evaluation of software functionality. Successful completion leads to an AUPP degree in Interactive App Design and Development and a Fort Hays State University degree in Web and Mobile Application Development.
